largest_vegas_favorite.note: Largest raw Vegas favorite this week (-520 ML, -10.5 vs NYG, ~80% no-vig implied). Never the recommendation by policy. The Arbiter cut it to 0.72 (0-3 at home, 4 starters OUT, a line move already priced for NYG's QB change), which ties MIN (used) and tops NYJ's 0.62, so the policy is what moves the pick to NYJ.

status_note: Eliminated from the main prize (1 mistake: Week 2 TB). Playing for fewest mistakes, so no opportunity-cost logic: the recommendation is the highest Arbiter probability among non-excluded, unused teams.
process_note: Byes: BUF, JAX, LAC, WAS. Shortlist of 13 got the full Advocate/Skeptic/Arbiter debate, including used MIN, DET, SF and KC. Excluded from recommendation: HOU (largest Vegas favorite), LA (trap flag), and used MIN/DET/SF/KC. Lessons applied: L16 (DEN and DET capped for own yards diff), L14 (LA trap), L7 (DAL vs a backup QB), L8 (SF without Bosa vs ATL's run game), L12 (Mayfield/Lamar questionable tags not treated as OUT). Watch Friday/Sunday: Mayfield (affects CAR) and Lamar (affects BAL/CIN).

board.summary: The Skeptic is right that the line moved because NYG changed QBs (L6/L7, already priced), HOU has 4 confirmed starters OUT, and it's 0-3 at home. As the largest raw-ML favorite it takes the L2 haircut. HOU's own form still holds (two straight wins, +25.8 vs NYG's +8.8 yds/g), so it stays a clear favorite, well below the 0.80 market. Excluded as the largest Vegas favorite.

board.summary: The Skeptic wins decisively. This is the L14 profile, worse now: 2-4 despite +107 yds/g, kicking dysfunction plus K Grupe's ACL tear, Adams on IR, Ford and Turner out, Nacua questionable. LV's takeaway rate against LA's negative turnover margin is exactly how yards fail to become points. Trap-flagged and excluded.

trap_flags: Favorite's own offense confirmed compromised (L10/L12/L14): WR Davante Adams on IR and the new K Grupe out for the season (ACL), on top of a kicking/red-zone dysfunction that already cost LA an outright loss as a 12.5-pt favorite last week, with Nacua questionable. A 2-4 team whose record trails its efficiency is priced like a 61% road favorite.
